summary: Bello called for a Gaza ceasefire and demanded the US halt financial support for the war in a February 2024 interview as a YUCA member in East Palo Alto. CAIR Action endorsed her in the general election, and Vote for Peace rated her an Ally. Both organizations evaluate candidates on Gaza and war-lobby positions. Her early public advocacy and the endorsement-level support place her among candidates opposing US military assistance to Israel.
